1: imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam |
2: sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa ||
3: sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ |
bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam ||
4: aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ |
katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti ||
5: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna |
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa ||
7: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata |
9: janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ |
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna ||
11: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham |
12: kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ |
kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā ||
13: tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam ||
14: na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā |
iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate ||
15: evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ |
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam ||
16: kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ |
tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt ||
17: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ |
akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ ||
18: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ |
sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit ||
21: śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham ||
22: samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate ||
24: brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam |
32: evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe |
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase ||
35: yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava |
36: api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ |
38: na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate |
40: nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ ||
